note: Re-judged 2026-10-23 (independent auditor, after 9242dcd57b and a59427f8c0). RFC 4760 Section 7: "If a BGP speaker receives from a neighbor an UPDATE message that contains the MP_REACH_NLRI or MP_UNREACH_NLRI attribute, and if the speaker determines that the attribute is incorrect, the speaker MUST delete all the BGP routes received from that neighbor whose AFI/SAFI is the same as the one carried in the incorrect MP_REACH_NLRI or MP_UNREACH_NLRI attribute." Read the changed units TestRFC4760IncorrectMPAttributeResetsTheSession (both tags): the next-hop-length case (IPv6 unicast, Length of Next Hop 8, value 13 octets so the Section 5.3 floor cannot fire first) still requires exact SessionReset with AttrCode 14, and now also the NOTIFICATION 3/9 with Data equal to the whole attribute; a new direct-call subtest drives validateMPReachNextHop with a 3-octet value (unreachable through the walk because validateMPAttrLength refuses < 5 first) and requires the same; MP_UNREACH length 2 still requires SessionReset with AttrCode 15; a well-formed IPv6 MP_REACH requires ActionNone. Producers read: rfc7606.go ValidateUpdateRFC7606AddPath now calls validateMPAttrLength and validateMPReachNextHop in the walk, both returning SessionReset carrying MPAttributeErrorNotification(attr) (3/9, Data = flags, type, length, value, per RFC 4760 Section 7 SHOULD and RFC 4271 Section 6.3); session_validation.go applyRFC7606 sends result.Notification through rfc7606ResetNotification, which closes the connection. The changes only add the NOTIFICATION assertions; the trigger half (reset on incorrect, none on correct) is unchanged, and the deletion half (rib TestRFC4760PeerDownDeletesOnlyThatNeighborsRoutes, TestHandleState_PeerDown, reactor rfc4760_peer_down_link and rfc4760_section7 units, unchanged) still proves the routes of the offending AFI/SAFI are deleted when the session resets. Session reset is the RFC 7606 Section 3 (j) branch and deletes a superset of the routes Section 7 names. Verdict stands. Ran the message-package units and the reactor TestRFC4760 units green over the tree. Findings recorded outside this verdict: the rfc4760_section7_test.go claims still name rfc7606SessionReset where the MP NLRI overrun now resets through rfc7606ResetNotification, and the reactor discrimination record on TestRFC4760CorrectMPReachRaisesNoPeerDown no longer verifies (producer-changed applyRFC7606).
